sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Slime Clicker are simple yet engaging. Players take on the role of a hunter tasked with capturing various slimes to earn gold coins. The game features a wide range of slimes, each with its unique characteristics, rarity, and timer. This variety ensures that players always have something new to look forward to and keeps the gameplay fresh. The slimes' timers range from a few seconds to several minutes, depending on their rarity and level. Players must click on the slimes before their timers expire to earn gold coins.

When a player clicks on a slime, they earn gold coins based on the slime's level and rarity. The level of the slime determines its health, and the more health a slime has, the more gold coins it produces. Players can upgrade their slimes to increase their health and gold coin earnings. The upgrades also increase the slimes' timers, making it easier for players to click on them before they expire.

The game's core mechanics offer a sense of progression, making it an engaging experience for players. As players upgrade their slimes and earn gold coins, they can purchase new slimes, upgrades, and other items to enhance their gameplay experience.
